verdict.rationale: Foreloop's documented design has you run your own coding agent, Claude Code or Codex, on your own machine to claim and work tasks. That agent's model and credentials therefore stay your choice. The API keys in the docs are Foreloop's own keys for MCP, the CLI and the widget, not LLM provider keys. There is no evidence you can choose the model behind Foreloop's own agents, such as the one that drafts intentions from feedback or the one that runs PR reviews. Missing for 10: documented support for supplying your own LLM provider key or model, model choice beyond Claude Code/Codex, BYO model for Foreloop's hosted intention and review agents, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice

citations.quote: You run an agent — Claude Code or Codex — in a checkout of your repository on your own machine.
